parsed.name: Nobø Ecohub 供暖控制集线器
parsed.description: 用于 Nobø 电采暖系统的网络集线器，可在局域网中发现并连接供暖分区与组件，管理周程序、舒适/节能/离家等覆盖模式，并读取分区或组件温度，适合实验室房间供暖与环境温度管理。
parsed.description_en: A network-connected hub for Nobø electric heating systems. It can discover and connect heating zones and components on a local network, manage weekly schedules and comfort/eco/away overrides, and read zone or component temperatures for room heating and environmental temperature management in labs.
